I have not fixed the bug yet. My attempt to call propose_patch failed with "No such tool available", and the only tool I have in this session is the structured-output tool. So the patch is not applied and run_tests has not been run. Nothing has been verified.

Cause: SQLite returns PasswordResetToken.expires_at as a naive datetime, but reset_password compares it with datetime.now(timezone.utc), an aware datetime. Python raises TypeError on that comparison. The token was stored as UTC, so treating the naive value as UTC is correct.

Proposed fix for app/routers/auth.py (the only file that should change), to be applied with propose_patch and then verified with run_tests on tests/test_auth_login.py::AuthLoginTests::test_password_reset_accepts_a_valid_database_token and on tests/:
